water.low: Expected to meet state standards. Still avoid swimming near storm drains and river mouths.
water.moderate: If you go in, stay away from river mouths and storm drains, keep your head above water, and rinse off afterward.
water.high: Stay out of the water. Check the County's beach status page for closures and advisories.
water.very_high: Stay out of the water. Check the County's beach status page for closures and advisories.
water.none: Check the County's beach status page for the nearest monitored beach.

heat.moderate: Drink water and limit hard outdoor work in the afternoon.
heat.high: Stay in shade or air conditioning in the afternoon, drink water, and check on older neighbors.
heat.very_high: Avoid outdoor exertion, use a cool place or cooling center, and check on older neighbors and anyone living alone.
heat.none: Check the state CalHeatScore for your ZIP.

flood.moderate: Expect water close to the top of seawalls and beach access ramps at high tide.
flood.high: Avoid parking or driving on low streets near the bay and beach around the peak time.
flood.very_high: Move cars from low streets near the shore and avoid flooded roads; follow NWS Coastal Flood warnings.
flood.none: This place is away from the shore.

air.moderate: Unusually sensitive people should consider shorter outdoor exertion.
air.usg: People with asthma or heart or lung disease, children and older adults should reduce long or hard outdoor exertion.
air.unhealthy: Everyone should reduce long or hard outdoor exertion; sensitive groups should avoid it.
air.very_unhealthy: Avoid outdoor exertion. Keep windows closed and use clean air if available.
air.hazardous: Stay indoors with windows closed and follow public health guidance.
air.none: See AirNow for current air quality.

fire.moderate: Avoid activities that cause sparks outdoors.
fire.high: Avoid sparks: no mowing or equipment use in dry grass. Know your evacuation route.
fire.very_high: Be ready to leave. Follow CAL FIRE and local evacuation orders.
fire.none: Follow CAL FIRE and local alerts for active fires.
